title: ziviSynthi AKS: An Open-Source Pin-Matrix Synthesizer Firmware Inspired by the EMS Synthi AKS
description:
ziviSynthi AKS is an independent research instrument for digital lutherie and embedded music computing. Inspired by the EMS Synthi AKS, it pairs a 16 × 16 signal and modulation matrix with a C synthesis engine for the M-VAVE SMK-37 Pro and a bilingual Web Studio for browser synthesis, patch editing and communication over USB MIDI.

Instrumento de pesquisa em luteria digital e computação musical embarcada, inspirado no EMS Synthi AKS. Reúne uma matriz 16 × 16 e um núcleo de síntese em C para o M-VAVE SMK-37 Pro e um Web Studio bilíngue.
